method: All source items checked against Archive indexed formats; complete file listings checked for every item with caption/text/unknown/index formats or absent from the search index, plus cached recent file inventories. Embedded tracks probed separately in a bounded sample.
note: Availability audit only. Index absence is not proof that embedded or external subtitles do not exist. Exact file matches still need language/dialogue and synchronization review. No embedded-video absence is implied by missing sidecars. No caption links were changed.
validationNote: Near-full-extent requires at least five cues and a last cue reaching at least 95% of the video timeline without overrunning it by more than 2% or ten seconds. This is endpoint extent, not speech coverage or synchronization. Language and dialogue synchronization remain unreviewed. No captions enabled.
